sanskrit_verse: दुहिता चार्यभार्या च सगोत्रा शरणागता । राज्ञी प्रव्रजिता धात्री साध्वी वर्णोत्तमा च या ॥
transliteration: duhitā cāryabhāryā ca sagotrā śaraṇāgatā | rājñī pravrajitā dhātrī sādhvī varṇottamā ca yā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Daughter, wife of the teacher, of same lineage, surrendered unto, queen, renunciate, nurse, virtuous woman, and highest-caste woman—these categories of women are to be protected by all means as embodiments of Dharma and consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Protection of women is a sovereign duty rooted in Dharma, not social convention.
Causation: Vulnerability and spiritual station confer inherent claim to protection.
Capacity-based responsibility: Society's capacity determines its obligation to safeguard these classes.
Restoration logic: Harm to these beings disrupts cosmic order; restoration aligns with Dharma.
Consciousness alignment: These beings represent elevated states of consciousness and must be preserved as such.
executable_legal_axioms: IF SUBJECT is IN category [daughter, teacher's wife, same gotra, surrendered, queen, renunciate, nurse, virtuous, highest caste] THEN STATE must activate full-spectrum protective protocols.
IF HARM is detected TO any of the above THEN RESTORATION priority overrides procedural delay.
IF PROTECTION is withheld THEN RESPONSIBILITY defaults to nearest capable authority until realigned.
IF THREAT is IMPLIED toward any of the above THEN PREEMPTIVE SHIELDING is mandatory.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any threat or harm to these designated beings invokes immediate constitutional activation of restorative justice mechanisms. The court must prioritize consciousness preservation over procedural formalities, recognizing these beings as vessels of Dharma whose violation disrupts national integrity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that injury to these beings causes irreversible disruption to Dharma’s flow. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how neglect leads to societal collapse. Responsibility is proportional to capacity to protect. Retribution is irrelevant; only completion of protective duty restores balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all protective duties toward these beings are fulfilled without exception.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Assign guardianship to nearest capable entity until safety is secured.
Capacity Restoration: Realign societal structures to ensure no future failure in protection.
Integrity Reintegration: Public acknowledgment and ritual restoration of violated Dharma-space.
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is declared: Protection of these beings is non-negotiable. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
